questionText: How much heat is absorbed by \(0.05\,\text{kg}\) of copper \([c=390\,\text{J\,kg}^{-1}\text{K}^{-1}]\) heated from \(20^\circ\text{C}\) to \(70^\circ\text{C}\)?
In a liquid-in-glass thermometer, sensitivity is enhanced if the

options.A: volume expansivity of the liquid is high
options.B: thermal conductivity of the liquid is low
options.C: diameter of the capillary tube is large
options.D: boiling point of the liquid is high

explanation: High volume expansivity causes greater expansion for a small temperature change, increasing sensitivity.

explanation: For a closed pipe, first overtone: \(L=\dfrac{3\lambda}{4}\Rightarrow\lambda=\dfrac{4\times33}{3}=44\,\text{cm}\)
